summary: Serializes the auto-load entry linked list to the physics config file. Builds the physics file path into a 256-byte buffer, zero-inits a local file struct, opens the file (after toggling the read-only attribute on a 512-byte name buffer), then walks the linked list from this+0x24 head, writing each node through AutoLoadEntryWriter while advancing through next pointers at node+4; closes the file and runs conditional cleanup. Non-zero PhysicsFilePathBuild result short-circuits the whole write.

local_names.this: auto-load list owner; this+0x1C head, this+0x24 current-node iterator
local_names.a2: config path argument passed to PhysicsFilePathBuild
local_names.v7: local file-handle struct zeroed by ZeroInitSmallStruct
local_names.FileName: 512-byte file name buffer used for the read-only attribute call

operations.description: PhysicsFilePathBuild(a2, v8, 256) builds the physics file path into the 256-byte local buffer
PhysicsFilePathBuild result guards the whole write: when non-zero the function returns it immediately, skipping all file and list processing
ZeroInitSmallStruct(v7) zero-initializes the local file-handle struct
sub_568620(512) sets the file buffer size on the file handle
ToggleFileReadOnlyAttributeViaWin32API(FileName, 128) toggles the read-only attribute on the 512-byte FileName buffer
File open result from sub_566940(v8, 0, 1, 1) gates the list-write block: entries are only written while the file open succeeds
pCurrent iterator at this+0x24 is seeded from pHead at this+0x1C before the walk begins
Node-validity gate: the walk proceeds only while the head node pointer and its data/flag word at offset 0 (this+0x28 data area) are non-zero

do/while walk over the auto-load linked list: AutoLoadEntryWriter(v7) writes each node, then the iterator advances by reading the next pointer at node+4 into this+0x24, looping while the next node's data at offset 0 is non-zero
ConditionalFileHandleCloseWithFlagDispatch(v7) closes the file handle after the list write
SubCallWithConditionalFieldFree(v7) performs conditional cleanup with field free and its result is returned; the early guard path returns the PhysicsFilePathBuild result directly

unresolved: The linked-list node element layout beyond node+0 (data/flag) and node+4 (next) is not defined by this packet
